### Top AI Tools for Donor Research in Nonprofits

AI is transforming donor research by analyzing vast datasets on wealth, philanthropy, giving patterns, and engagement to identify high-potential donors, predict behaviors, and prioritize outreach. Below, I summarize the most relevant tools from current search results, focusing on their core features, benefits, and use cases for prospect research.

#### 1. **DonorSearch Ai** (Most Advanced Predictive Modeling)
   - **Overview**: Built on the world's largest philanthropic database, this machine learning tool creates customizable predictive models from your donor records and prospect data.
   - **Key Features**:
     | Prediction Type | Accuracy/Use Case |
     |-----------------|-------------------|
     | Most Likely to Respond (MLR) Score | Identifies prospects ready for outreach |
     | Repeat Donor Likelihood | 81% accuracy for sustainers |
     | New Donor Acquisition | Spots first-time givers |
     | Retention & Upgrades | Year-over-year predictions and lifetime value |
   - **Benefits**: Reduces portfolio prioritization from 4 hours to minutes; integrates with 40+ CRMs; enhances screening for major gifts (e.g., top 20% donors drive 80% revenue).
   - **Best For**: Nonprofits seeking deep, data-driven prospect pipelines.
   - **Source**: [DonorSearch Ai](https://www.donorsearch.net/donorsearch-ai/), [Resources](https://www.donorsearch.net/resources/ai-for-nonprofits/).

#### 2. **DonorAtlas** (AI-Powered Profiles from Open Web)
   - **Overview**: Generates instant, verified profiles on prospects by sourcing and citing data from across the web.
   - **Key Features**:
     - On-demand research: Builds complete profiles in seconds if not pre-existing.
     - Detailed context: Wealth, connections to your mission, all sources cited.
     - CRM integration for seamless workflow.
   - **Benefits**: Cuts research time by 75%; focuses team on strategy over data aggregation.
   - **Best For**: Quick, comprehensive donor profiling without manual searches.
   - **Source**: [DonorAtlas](https://www.donoratlas.com).

#### 3. **Dataro** (Fundraising Intelligence Platform)
   - **Overview**: Analyzes donor databases to rank prospects and recommend actions.
   - **Key Features**: Turns raw data into prioritized lists (e.g., who to contact now, next steps).
   - **Benefits**: Detects patterns and changes in donor behavior at scale.
   - **Best For**: Actionable insights from existing donor data.
   - **Source**: [Dataro](https://dataro.io).

#### Additional AI Applications in Donor Research
- **Personalization & Segmentation**: Tools like those from Fidelity Charitable use AI to tailor communications based on giving history and segment donors for targeted reports ([source](https://www.fidelitycharitable.org/articles/ai-tools-every-nonprofit-needs.html)).
- **Pattern Detection**: AI scans databases for shifts in behavior, accelerating research ([Adagetech](https://adagetech.com/blog/utilizing-artificial-intelligence-for-fundraising-excellence/)).
- **Free Options**: Leverage general AI (e.g., paste 990s into chatbots) to uncover funder priorities ([AFP Global](https://afpglobal.org/leveraging-ai-without-spending-dime)).

| Tool | Strengths | Ideal Nonprofit Size | Pricing Note |
|------|-----------|----------------------|--------------|
| DonorSearch Ai | Custom predictions, high accuracy | Mid-to-large | Subscription-based |
| DonorAtlas | Speed, web-sourced profiles | Small-to-mid | Not specified |
| Dataro | Action rankings | All sizes | Intelligence platform |

Start with DonorSearch Ai or DonorAtlas for robust prospecting. These tools emphasize augmentation—not replacement—of human judgment, ensuring ethical use of donor data. For demos, visit the linked sites.
